description: Rework RuntimeConsistencyValidator.CheckRunnerIdentityAsync to poll /api/runner/identity with a bounded, injectable retry window so a full `mo update` no longer false-warns 'did not respond' while the runner is still registering.

tasks.title: Poll /api/runner/identity with bounded retry in CheckRunnerIdentityAsync
tasks.description: Rework `RuntimeConsistencyValidator.CheckRunnerIdentityAsync` (packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/Update/RuntimeConsistencyValidator.cs) so that after resolving the source HEAD it polls the existing `TryGetRunnerIdentityAsync` helper until either a non-null identity snapshot is returned, or a bounded timeout elapses. Add optional constructor params `TimeProvider? timeProvider = null`, `TimeSpan? runnerIdentityTimeout = null`, `TimeSpan? runnerIdentityPollInterval = null` (defaults: TimeProvider.System / 30s / 500ms, matching RunnerRefreshVerifier) following the ServiceReadinessProbe time-injection convention (GetUtcNow deadline + Task.Delay(interval, timeProvider, token)). A `null` snapshot means 'poll again'; a non-null snapshot exits the loop and is evaluated by the existing comparison block unchanged (empty hash -> Warn, mismatch -> Warn, match -> Pass). Leave the three production construction sites (MohistCliCommands.cs, MohistCliCommands.Update.cs, Program.cs) compiling unchanged via the optional defaults. Extend the `BuildValidator` helper in RuntimeConsistencyValidatorSpecs.cs to thread a FakeTimeProvider, and add the three required timing specs (identity immediate / identity after N polls / identity never within window) driven by fake HTTP + fake time only.
acceptanceCriteria: `CheckRunnerIdentityAsync` polls `/api/runner/identity` (via the existing `TryGetRunnerIdentityAsync` helper, not duplicated HTTP code) until a non-null identity snapshot arrives, instead of issuing a single GET. A present snapshot with an empty `buildGitHash` remains the unchanged Warn path.

Constructor accepts injectable `TimeProvider`, timeout, and poll interval with defaults TimeProvider.System / 30s / 500ms; the three existing production construction sites (MohistCliCommands.cs:141, MohistCliCommands.Update.cs:166, Program.cs:21) compile unchanged.

All waiting is driven through the injected `TimeProvider`: deadline via `GetUtcNow() + timeout`, inter-probe delay via `Task.Delay(interval, timeProvider, token)`. No `DateTime.UtcNow`, no `Environment.TickCount`, no `CancellationTokenSource(timeout)` keyed off a wall clock.
Identity available on first probe returns Pass with zero poll delays (no leading delay before the first attempt).
Identity returning null/empty for N probes then a matching hash before timeout returns Pass, having issued N-1 poll delays.
Identity never becoming available within the bounded window still returns Warn with the 'did not respond' message (real failures not masked).

Present-but-unusable outcomes unchanged: non-null identity with empty `buildGitHash` -> Warn (no further polling); non-null identity with mismatched `buildGitHash` -> Warn (no further polling); unresolvable source HEAD -> skip Warn with zero HTTP probes.

New unit specs in RuntimeConsistencyValidatorSpecs.cs cover the three timing scenarios (immediate / polled / timed-out) using FakeTimeProvider + fake HTTP only; existing identity specs whose handlers answer on the first call remain green unchanged, and the existing CheckRunnerIdentityAsync_EndpointUnreachable_ReportsWarn (handler always returns 503 -> null every call, now exercises the timeout path) is retrofitted with a FakeTimeProvider + short timeout or folded into the new 'never available within window' spec so it does not block for the 30s default window.
`npm test` (server) green; CLI project builds with TreatWarningsAsErrors; `packages/cli` tests pass with the new specs included.
tasks.output: Modified packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/Update/RuntimeConsistencyValidator.cs (poll loop + constructor params), unchanged-but-verified construction sites in MohistCliCommands.cs / MohistCliCommands.Update.cs / Program.cs, and extended packages/cli/tests/Mohist.Cli.Tests/RuntimeConsistencyValidatorSpecs.cs with three new timing specs.
tasks.notes: Do NOT touch RunnerRefreshVerifier, RestoreRunner's systemd gate, the mo update stage machine, the /api/runner/identity API contract, runner registration, the WebSocket handshake, or the buildGitHash comparison logic. Reuse TryGetRunnerIdentityAsync as the per-attempt probe unchanged. Optional constructor params keep the three production call sites compiling without edits.
